requirements.description: Provide SCLK, CS# and MOSI_IO0 host-to-DUT paths and MISO_IO1 DUT-to-host path. This is a logical direction requirement, not a verified translator pin map.
Evaluate a local nominal 1.8 V DUT supply against the declared 1.7–1.95 V VCC range, including tolerance, load and transients. Keep default power off. VCC range does not establish I/O tolerance.
Require exact physical DUT identity, package-specific pinout and electrical-limit evidence before implementation approval; preserve absence of physical evidence.
